rationale: M49 W9 F6 adjudication. metadata.argumentCount must count ARGUMENTS. The pre-fix guard skipped a node type named `comment`, which the pinned tree-sitter-java grammar does not define — comments are `line_comment` / `block_comment` — so the guard could never fire and a comment inside an argument list was counted as an argument (`b2(1 /* inline */, 2)` -> 3, `e0(/* nothing */)` -> 1; probe-verified). Each call below has its own target so no clean sibling can satisfy the pin: a2 is the no-comment control, b2/c2 are trailing/leading inline comments, d1 has an argument beside a comment, e0 is a comment-only (EMPTY) argument list.
